jobs.title: Team Lead - Invoices
jobs.description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. About the role Invoices is BLP's largest product. Every day, it decides whether a supplier invoice can be posted to the customer's ERP without a human touching it. The invoice team builds and runs that product. This is a leadership job with three parts that are equally important: Build the team. The team is growing fast and is distributed across Zurich and several European countries. You hire, onboard, and grow engineers, and you develop the subteam leads who will carry more of the line management as we scale. Deliver for our biggest customers. Some of the largest enterprises in Europe are rolling out BLP right now. Their go-lives, automation rates, and escalations land on your desk, and you make sure the team delivers on what we promised. jobs.title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
jobs.description: CrossFit is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to help shape the next chapter of one of the world's most recognizable brands in health and fitness. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer and serving as a key member of the executive leadership team, the CFO will lead the company's global finance organization while partnering closely with leaders across the business to drive growth, operational excellence, and long-term value creation. This is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in CrossFit's continued transformation—building financial strategies that support innovation, strengthen our affiliate ecosystem, and position the company for sustained success. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Significant executive finance leadership experience with responsibility for large, complex P&Ls. Proven experience serving as a CFO or senior finance executive in a high-growth, transformation-focused environment. Private equity experience with a demonstrated track record of driving value creation. Experience leading organizations through periods of change, transformation, and growth. Deep expertise in financial planning, capital allocation, operational finance, and strategic decision-making. Exceptional leadership, communication, and executive influencing skills. High integrity, sound judgment, and the ability to balance strategic vision with operational execution. CPA, MBA, or equivalent advanced financial credentials preferred. The strongest candidates will also have: A genuine connection to CrossFit, whether through participating in the methodology, supporting the affiliate community, or a deep understanding of what makes the CrossFit ecosystem unique. Experience working with consumer brands, affiliate or franchise business models, or membership-based organizations. A passion for building high-performing teams, developing leaders, and fostering a culture of accountability and collaboration. WHAT WE OFFER Rich medical, dental, and vision plans Unlimited Paid Time

jobs.title: Meeloopstage Cash Control/ Finance
jobs.description: Wil jij ontdekken hoe de financiële motor achter een internationale logistiek dienstverlener draait? Ben je nauwkeurig, analytisch en krijg je energie van cijfers die kloppen? Dan is deze meeloopstage iets voor jou! Voor ons Cash Control team in Rotterdam zoeken we een stagiair(e) die meedraait in het dagelijkse cashmanagement. Je helpt bij het tijdig toewijzen van betalingen, het verwerken van bankafschriften en het bewaken van openstaande posten. Je werkt nauw samen met Credit Control, Invoicing en Accounts Payable en doet zo praktijkervaring op met cash application, reconciliaties en werken in ERP-systeem Exact. Waar ga je werken? Royal Den Hartogh Logistics is een internationale, toonaangevende logistiek dienstverlener voor de chemische, gas-, polymeer- en voedingsmiddelenindustrie. Ons familiebedrijf bestaat al sinds 1920 en heeft veiligheid en duurzaamheid stevig in het DNA verankerd. Met 54 locaties in 27 landen en ruim 2.600 collega's wereldwijd werken we continu aan slimme, toekomstbestendige logistieke oplossingen. Ons finance team in Nederland telt 20 collega's, verdeeld over onder andere Credit Control, Invoicing, Accounts Payable en Cash Control – en daar kom jij als stagiair(e) terecht. Wat ga je doen? Je bewaakt de dagelijkse Unallocated Cash : je houdt het overzicht bij, volgt openstaande posten op en rapporteert de belangrijkste KPI's. Je zoekt niet-herkende ontvangsten en niet-gematchte betalingen uit en helpt ze oplossen. Je boekt en verwerkt dagelijks bankafschriften in Exact, voor meerdere bankrekeningen en entiteiten (inkomend en uitgaand). Je matcht klantontvangsten en leveranciersbetalingen aan de juiste facturen. Je helpt bij bankreconciliaties en spoort verschillen op tussen bankafschriften en de administratie. Je denkt mee over verbeteringen om het toewijzen en afletteren efficiënter te maken. De ideale kandidaat Je volgt een mbo4- of hbo-opleiding in een financiële richting, zoals Finance & Control, Bedrijfsadministratie, Bedrijfseconomie

jobs.description: PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk (BSI) adalah bank di Indonesia yang bergerak di bidang perbankan syariah. BSI merupakan bank hasil merger antara PT Bank BRI syariah Tbk, PT Bank Syariah Mandiri dan PT Bank BNI Syariah. Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) secara resmi mengeluarkan izin merger tiga usaha bank syariah tersebut pada 27 Januari 2021 melalui surat Nomor SR-3/PB.1/2021. Berikut ini adalah Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk. Komposisi pemegang saham BSI adalah: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk 50,83%, PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 24,85%, PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk 17,25%. Sisanya adalah pemegang saham yang masing-masing di bawah 5%. Penggabungan ini menyatukan kelebihan dari ketiga bank syariah tersebut, sehingga menghadirkan layanan yang lebih lengkap, jangkauan lebih luas, serta memiliki kapasitas permodalan yang lebih baik. Didukung sinergi dengan perusahaan serta komitmen pemerintah melalui Kementerian BUMN, BSI didorong untuk dapat bersaing di tingkat global. Lowongan Kerja PT Bank Syariah Indonesia Tbk Saat ini PT Bank Syariah Indonesia (BSI) membuka kesempatan untuk dapat bergabung bersama dengan posisi sebagai berikut: Private Banking Relationship Manager Key Responsibilities: Build and manage long-term relationships with High Net Worth Individuals (HNWIs) and affluent clients Provide tailored wealth management, investment, and financial planning solutions aligned with clients financial goals Grow Assets Under Management (AUM) through portfolio development, client acquisition, and relationship expansion Deliver holistic advisory services across investment, protection, and wealth preservation solutions Identify new business opportunities through networking, referrals, and market engagement Maintain the highest standards of client service, professionalism, confidentiality, and regulatory compliance Requirements: Bachelor s Degree (S1) from any discipline. Minimum 5 years of experience in Banking, Wealth Management, Priority Banking
